items.q: Buster Cooper, the great trombone player in the sixties, he and I and this great bass player from then, John Lamb.

ctx.x: It’s on Nickelodeon. I used to do another one called “Rocko’s Modern Life.” And I love playing that, cartoons. So this guy, so we’ll be there probably a good part of the day on Tuesday. Tuesday night I have a rehearsal for a big band for the one I was telling you about at this Quaker School and we’re going to do a concert for them on Thursday afternoon. And it’s just more stuff coming up. I mean you know I’m going to England. Oh, the band is going for about three days to a jazz festival. Then I’m going over as a…
left, but Buster Cooper, the great trombone player in the sixties, he and I and this great bass player from then, John Lamb. They had a great—
